title: S&P DJI September quarterly rebalance takes effect at the open — S&P 500/100/400/600 membership and float changes, implemented at the 2026-09-18 close
source: NEWS: owner-published, re-fetched and re-extracted independently this session. S&P Dow Jones Indices press release dated Sept 4, 2026, "Bloom Energy, Illumina, and Everpure Set to Join S&P 500; Others to Join S&P 100, S&P MidCap 400, and S&P SmallCap 600", fetched direct from the owner's own newsroom 2026-09-08 (press.spglobal.com/2026-09-04-Bloom-Energy,-Illumina,-and-Everpure-Set-to-Join-S-P-500-..., HTTP 200, 79,423 bytes, body extracted in-session; located from the newsroom's own dated index at press.spglobal.com/index.php?s=2429&l=100, HTTP 200, which carries the release under a "Sep 4, 2026" date stamp). The effective-date wording is verbatim: S&P DJI "will make the following changes to the S&P 500, S&P 100, S&P MidCap 400, and S&P SmallCap 600 indices effective prior to the open of trading on Monday, September 21, 2026, to coincide with the quarterly rebalance", and the release's own table stamps every one of its 34 index/action rows "Sept 21, 2026". THE FULL ROSTER READ FROM THE TABLE, not inherited from the proposal: S&P 500 additions Bloom Energy (BE), Everpure (P), Illumina (ILMN); S&P 500 deletions Molson Coors Beverage (TAP), The Trade Desk (TTD), Builders FirstSource (BLDR); S&P 100 additions Dell (DELL), Palo Alto Networks (PANW), Arista (ANET), Sandisk (SNDK); S&P 100 deletions Honeywell Aerospace (HONA), NIKE (NKE), Simon Property (SPG), Colgate-Palmolive (CL); plus a full MidCap 400 and SmallCap 600 reshuffle. Filed estimate on the two limits this lane has recorded before: the confirmed-prefix taxonomy in market-events-data.ts has no member for an index owner's own published schedule (the same gap russell-quarterly-ipo-review-effective-2026-09-21 and every Russell entry record), and this lane may not self-confirm. The DATE IS THE OWNER'S OWN, published in its own newsroom, and is not in doubt — the estimate label is about the taxonomy, not the evidence. Checked 2026-09-08
notes: CANONICAL FILE WRITTEN BY THIS EVENT'S OWN INITIAL RESEARCH (2026-09-08), which read the single proposal carrying this id (proposals/sp-quarterly-rebalance-effective-2026-09-21.from-opex-2026-09-18.json) in full first and then re-fetched and re-extracted the owner's press release rather than inheriting its readings. Ledger: docs/research/events/sp-quarterly-rebalance-effective-2026-09-21.md. WHAT THE RE-EXTRACTION FOUND THAT THE PROPOSAL DID NOT: the three S&P 500 deletions are not expulsions. TAP, TTD and BLDR each appear TWICE in the release's own table — once as an S&P 500 Deletion and once as an S&P SmallCap 600 Addition — so they migrate two tiers down inside the S&P Composite 1500 rather than leaving it, and the additions P and ILMN migrate UP out of the MidCap 400. Ten of the release's moves are migrations of this kind, which means the 2026-09-18 closing imbalance in a migrating name is the NET of two trackers' flows, not the gross of one. THE INITIAL RESEARCH MEASURED THE EVENT AND SPLIT ITS ANSWER IN TWO. At index level the effective open is a null: SPY's total return on the Monday after the third Friday, 2005-2026, runs 40 of 83 negative across the four quarterly legs (sign p=82.6%) and 12 of 21 on the September legs alone (p=66.4%), with no relative-volume step (1.02x quarterly vs 0.99x other months) -- which is why impact stays low. At CONSTITUENT level it is not a null and the effect is alive in the small-cap tier: on the 2026-09-08 announcement-reaction session, measured intraday, 28 of 32 named companies moved in the direction their index action predicts (sign p=0.002%), and the S&P SmallCap 600 cohort was perfect at 12 of 12 (5 additions +6.47% mean excess vs IJR, 7 clean-exit deletions -2.97%, spread 9.44pp, on 2.5-3.0x relative turnover) while the S&P 500 additions excluding Bloom Energy managed +0.49% -- the disappearing index effect the sp-rebalance-proforma-2026-09-04 sibling banked from Greenwood & Sammon is confirmed for the S&P 500 and REFUTED one tier down. Symbols deliberately EMPTY despite that finding, and the reason is the finding: the moves belong to individual constituents, not to this event's index-level tape, and a symbols array would make the deterministic screen trip on names like BE (+12% intraday, but already +15.7% excess in the two sessions BEFORE the after-close release, so contaminated and explicitly not scored as index-effect evidence). What the result argues for is a constituent-level instrument, filed as the ledger's own limit. ONE ADJACENT EVENT PROPOSED and two deliberately declined, recorded so a later lane does not re-litigate: PROPOSED sp-rebalance-proforma-2026-12-04, the December cycle's announcement, because this research measured the ANNOUNCEMENT rather than the effective date as the session where anything happens, and the calendar tracks neither December milestone. DECLINED the December capped pro-forma (2026-12-11) and the December effective open (2026-12-21) -- the same methodology rule dates both, but this research measured the effective date as an index-level null and the capped file as a non-event, so filing them would spend board attention on nothing. Kind 'sector' matches the sibling market-structure flow entries; the enum has no index-flow member and the imperfect fit is named, not fixed from this lane.
